$comment: Trusted third-party MCP servers (openspec add-integration-registry). Official vendor servers and well-known aggregators only, never community servers. Checked by packages/content/scripts/integrations.mjs; loaded by packages/core/src/integrations. Re-verify an entry (URL, auth, tool names) before bumping its verifiedAt.

capabilities.design.import: Bring a finished file (PDF, PPTX, image) into the service as an editable design
capabilities.design.upload: Upload a local file or asset into the service
capabilities.design.export: Export a design from the service as PDF, PNG, PPTX or similar
capabilities.design.read: Read a design's structure, layers, variables or content
capabilities.design.write: Create or edit designs in the service
capabilities.brand.kits: Read the user's brand kit (colors, fonts, logos)
capabilities.docs.write: Create or update a page or document
capabilities.storage.search: Find files in the user's storage
capabilities.storage.upload: Save a file into the user's storage
capabilities.team.share: Post a message, image or link to a team channel
capabilities.social.post: Publish or draft a post on a social network
capabilities.social.schedule: Schedule a social post for later

integrations.manualSetup:
X's official MCP server (xdevplatform/xmcp) runs on the user's own machine and needs their own X developer app.
1. Create an app at developer.x.com and note its consumer key/secret and bearer token. X API usage may be billed.
2. Follow the README at https://github.com/xdevplatform/xmcp to start the server locally; it serves http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp.
3. Add that local URL to this agent as an HTTP MCP server, then restart the agent.
caveats: Self-hosted: there is no hosted endpoint to connect to.
Media is uploaded through the server's chunked upload tools (initializeMediaUpload, appendMediaUpload, finalizeMediaUpload) before createPosts.

docs.notes: Self-hosted; set up by hand from [xdevplatform/xmcp](https://github.com/xdevplatform/xmcp)

caveats: Figma only accepts clients listed in its MCP catalog (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and VS Code are listed).
Write access differs per client: Codex supports Figma Design and FigJam only.
Load Figma's guidance before using it: skill://figma/figma-design-to-code/SKILL.md before get_design_context, skill://figma/figma-use/SKILL.md before use_figma (via get_figma_skill).

use_figma runs at most 50,000 characters of Plugin API code per call with no state between calls; push_open_design_artifact_to_figma prepares parts that fit. generate_figma_design is not on the hosted server. Push tested end to end 2026-10-10.
